d: In this episode of we will discuss the Supreme Court’s order on warning labels for packaged food and the one-year deadline given to the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI). We will explain what these warning labels could look like, which food products could carry them and how they would help consumers identify products high in sugar, salt and fat. We will also examine the existing food labelling system in India, the growing consumption of packaged food and its impact on public health.
